decision_basis: A post-freeze evaluator bug was discovered during the first and only official runtime exposure. The evaluator (scripts/t21r5_run_eval.py, frozen pre-holdout at sha256 feae0cbc...) crashed at line 186 with AttributeError: 'KnowledgeSourceRecord' object has no attribute 'get' on the first gold row carrying required_domains (crossdomain suite): the required-domains check calls s.get("domain") on KnowledgeSourceRecord instances returned by corpus.source(), which is a dataclass, not a mapping. The line exists only in the T21R5 evaluator - the T21R4 evaluator has no required-domains handling; the defect was introduced while adapting the evaluator for T21R5 gold and never exercised pre-freeze because the blindness rule forbids running the runtime on holdout data before HOLDOUT_FROZEN. Per the preregistered post_freeze_evaluator_bug_rule: 'If an evaluator bug is discovered after HOLDOUT_FROZEN or after the first evaluation starts: STOP. Do NOT fix and rerun T21R5. Decision is T21R5_EVALUATOR_INVALID; the exposed holdout becomes non-promotional and a future milestone with another fresh holdout is required.' The evaluation_run_ledger records exit_code 1, official_runtime_exposures 1, and the full traceback. No runtime, evaluator, gold, corpus, query, or threshold change was made after HOLDOUT_FROZEN.
registry_action: none - KNOWLEDGE_RAG remains EXPERIMENTAL, exactly as frozen in runtime_freeze.json; src/sciencemath/executive/skills.py is unchanged

evaluator_defect.provenance: introduced in the T21R5 evaluator adaptation; not present in scripts/t21r4_run_eval.py (no required-domains handling existed in T21R4)

partial_non_promotional_observations.note: Observations from the 1288 rows the single official exposure completed before the evaluator crashed. NON-PROMOTIONAL: the holdout is exposed, floors were never evaluated, and these numbers must not be used as validation evidence. They are diagnostic input for a future milestone.

multihop.failures: all 32 failures are INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE over-abstentions from exactly one MULTIHOP_Q phrasing ('Within which town was the author of {work} born?') across 32 distinct works; in every failing row the person-birthplace bridge chunk is absent from the final 8-item window (hop2 bridge does not join) and the measured coverage on the selected winner span is 0.0; all other 8 phrasings of the same works pass

protection_battery: 7 of 8 layers PASS; t21r4_freeze_identity FAIL on a T21R4-INHERITED bookkeeping defect, not a T21R5 change: evaluations/t21r4/holdout_manifest.json records freeze-input hashes for runtime_freeze.json, holdout_uniqueness.json and scripts/t21r4_freeze_evaluator.py that do not match the versions committed in the T21R4 terminal commit fbe034a / canonical base 6174ebd (the freeze-time file contents were never committed; T21R4's own battery ran before that finalization). git diff against 6174ebd proves nothing under those paths changed since the T21R4 merge. T21R5's own freeze-identity layer is PASS: every T21R5 freeze input, corpus file and suite hash matches.
post_freeze_repair_policy: FORBIDDEN - the holdout data is partially exposed after the one-shot run; any runtime or evaluator change informed by these results would invalidate the blind validation. A future milestone must build a NEW blind holdout with a NEW evaluator verified end-to-end before freezing.
